review.en: A short book in numbered aphoristic sections distinguishing two ways of standing toward the world: I–It, which uses and knows things, and I–Thou, the whole-hearted meeting with another, in which God is the eternal Thou. Its prose is compressed and sometimes oracular, but its central distinction passed into theology, education and therapy. In copyright: information only here.
review.zh: 一本以分节格言写成的小书，区分人对待世界的两种态度：“我—它”，即利用和认知事物；“我—你”，即全心全意与他者相遇，而上帝是永恒的“你”。文字凝练，有时近乎神谕，但这一核心区分深入影响了神学、教育和心理治疗。尚在版权期内，这里只收信息。
